channel.title: MapleSpike Blog
channel.description: Updates and releases from MapleSpike — Canadian government data API

item.title: Multiple Auth Methods: Web3, Passkey, OAuth
item.description: MapleSpike now supports Web3 wallet authentication via SIWE (EIP-4361), FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys, and generic OAuth 2.0 — all issuing the same JWT format.

item.title: Docs Overhaul: 10-Section API Reference
item.description: Complete documentation rewrite with quickstart, authentication, request/response format, token optimization, citation contract, 14-tool MCP catalog, rate limits, error codes, and FAQ.

item.title: 28 Canadian Government Data Modules
item.description: MapleSpike now ingests 28 data modules covering Parliament, lobbying, procurement, regulations, courts, elections, oversight, provincial legislatures, municipal data, and more.
